people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Jehoiakim
people.line: King of Judah, son of Josiah

people.name: Uriah
people.line: Prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem

translations.web: and they fetched Uriah out of Egypt, and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
translations.bsb: They brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who had him put to the sword and his body thrown into the burial place of the common people.
translations.kjv: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
translations.asv: and they fetched forth Uriah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king, who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
